concepts.gloss_en: Rectification/perfecting of the covenant (guarding sexual purity); the general positive tikkun of the brit
Rectification FOR the blemish of the covenant — remedy for damage already done (Elul kavanot); construct head is 'rectification for the blemish', not 'the covenant' itself

members.note: Different construct: tikkun directed at pgam ha-brit (the blemish), not the brit itself. Per rule 4, an action about X (repair of the blemish) is not the same node as tikkun ha-brit generally. Related but keep separate — human decides.

notes: Token-overlap only. תקון הברית is the broad positive concept (39x, foundational to LM); תקון לפגם הברית appears once (lm2:87) as a specific remedial act tied to Elul kavanot addressing pgam ha-brit. Under-merge preferred; do not collapse.
